proposals.after: Jue Luo Wu Mone, Shu Lan, La Xi, Wangzhar son of La Xi, Boling'a the grandson, Tulichen, and He Guozong

proposals.after: His grandson Boling'a inherited the family rank.

proposals.before: Dzungar taiji Tsewang Arabtan feuded with Ayuki; unable to return, Alabuzhur sought entry at the border, was enfeoffed as beile, and was given pasture outside Jiayu Pass at Dangse'erteng.
proposals.after: Dzungar taiji Tsewang Arabtan feuded with Ayuki; unable to return, Alabuzhur sought entry at the border, was enfeoffed as beizi, and was given pasture outside Jiayu Pass at Dangse'erteng.
proposals.reason: 貝子 is beizi, not beile (貝勒).

proposals.before: The Dzungar taiji Tsewang Arabtan bore a grudge against Ayuki; Alabuzhur could not return, came to the border seeking subject status, was enfeoffed as a beile, and granted pasture outside Jiayu Pass at Dangse'erteng.
proposals.after: The Dzungar taiji Tsewang Arabtan bore a grudge against Ayuki; Alabuzhur could not return, came to the border seeking subject status, was enfeoffed as a beizi, and granted pasture outside Jiayu Pass at Dangse'erteng.
proposals.reason: Chinese 貝子 corresponds to beizi rather than beile.

proposals.before: On New Year's Day of the sixth year they reached Manuotohai; Ayuki chose a day to receive the edict.
proposals.after: On the first day of the sixth month they reached Manuotohai; Ayuki chose a day to receive the edict.
proposals.reason: 六年朔 in this itinerary after the fifth month of Kangxi 53 is the first day of the sixth month (六月朔), not New Year of a sixth year.

proposals.before: On New Year's Day of the sixth year they reached Manuotohai; Ayuki chose a day to hear the edict proclaimed.
proposals.after: On the first day of the sixth month they reached Manuotohai; Ayuki chose a day to hear the edict proclaimed.
proposals.reason: 朔 marks the first day of a month; sequence requires sixth month, not a sixth year.

decisions.reason: In the chapter head-list, 拉錫子旺札爾孫博靈阿 pairs 子 and 孫 as kinship markers before personal names; 孫 is grandson, not the Chinese surname Sun. The proposed idiomatic correctly yields Boling'a the grandson.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 拉錫子旺札爾孫博靈阿

decisions.reason: The same head-list uses 孫 as kinship parallel to 子; rendering 孫博靈阿 as Sun Boling'a invents a surname. Boling'a the grandson matches the Chinese.
s0110 孫博靈阿，襲世職 already marks 孫 as grandson; adding English Sun as a surname is double-counting and false. His grandson Boling'a is accurate and natural.
Literal likewise turns kinship 孫 into a surname; removing Sun leaves His grandson Boling'a, which tracks 孫博靈阿 and 襲世職.
詔封貝子 is the Qing rank beizi; beile would require 貝勒. The proposed swap corrects a real title error and leaves the rest of the sentence intact.
The literal likewise misreads 貝子 as beile; beizi is the correct English for that rank.

After 五十三年四月 and 五月, 六年朔 cannot be New Year of a sixth year. Wikisource and CText preserve the received graph 六年朔, but 朔 is a month-day marker and the month-by-month itinerary requires the first day of the sixth month (六月朔); Tulichen's 異域錄 itinerary likewise places arrival at Manuotohai on 六月初一.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 五月，圖理琛等渡額濟勒河……六年朔，至瑪努託海

decisions.reason: CText's Qingshi Gao chapter likewise reads 六年朔 after the fifth-month crossing; as with the idiomatic, that received 年 is a corruption of 月 in context, and first day of the sixth month is the only coherent translation.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 五月，圖理琛等渡額濟勒河，阿喇布珠爾之父納扎爾瑪穆特遣獻馬，卻之。六年朔，至瑪努託海

claimRetractions.reason: Accepted r0003 shows alternate name Sun Boling'a arose only from mistaking kinship 孫 for a surname; s0110 supports personal name Boling'a (c0021), not a Sun Boling'a alias.
